why.evolution and setup: Its attacker is the Stage 2 Haxorus, reached through 2 Rare Candy with no Fraxure, and needs Fighting + Metal + Colorless.
why.Bench preparation: Frenzied Blade does +20 for each Benched Pokémon on both sides, so Axew, Goomy, Happiny and Roaring Moon are benched to raise it.
why.sacrifice and recovery: Goomy (Sticky Membrane), Happiny and Roaring Moon hold the Active Spot and get knocked out while Haxorus is built behind them.
why.control and combinations: Iris + Haxorus KO gives an extra point; Cyrus, Roaring Moon's Ancient Roar and Goomy's attack tax control the opponent's Active.

why.fast pressure: Wallace can evolve a Carvanha into Mega Sharpedo ex on turn 1, and Turbo Shark does 70 for one Water.
why.evolution and setup: Every attacker is a Stage 1 (Mega Sharpedo ex, Mega Gyarados ex, Milotic ex), helped by Wallace and Elegant Cape (+30 HP on Stage 1).
why.Bench preparation: Turbo Shark attaches Zone Water to a benched Water Pokémon, charging Magikarp/Gyarados and a second Sharpedo on the Bench.
Dede-Circuit does 40 per Tool on all his Pokémon, so benched Indeedee ex and Oricorio must carry Tools (Clear Veil, Giant Cape, Small Balloon).
why.control and combinations: Clear Veil blocks attack effects, Oricorio's Safeguard stops ex attackers, and Cyrus pulls up damaged targets.
why.sacrifice and recovery: Oricorio walls take hits while two Indeedee ex Watch Over heals and Starting Plains/Giant Cape keep Dedenne ex alive.

why.control and combinations: Damage comes from many small pieces: Darkrai ex's Nightmare Aura, Deceptive Needle, Rocky Helmet, Poison Barb, Hoopa ex's Bench snipe and Cyrus.
why.Bench preparation: Darkrai ex works from the Bench (Aura when Energy attaches), and Bombirdier on the Bench cuts the Active Darkness Pokémon's retreat cost.
